findings.title: sysid adoption interval misses the true UA on 14 of 22 fits it admits; admitted fits biased high
findings.claim: Under white room-sensor noise of 0.01-0.05 degC, 14 of the 22 two-state sysid fits that adoption_decision admits have the true UA outside their own 95 % interval (nominal ~5 %), and 21 of 22 over-estimate UA (mean +7.26 %, max +18.64 %).
findings.mechanism: The gate admits only fits whose profile interval is finite and narrow; with the comfort-bounded collinear window the realisations that produce a sharp profile are a biased subset (ensemble 95 % half-width of log UA 0.15-0.27 against admitted reported 0.05-0.09). One contributor: _simulate_slab_path anchors the hidden stores' held state on the single noisy first reading, an error source the interval does not carry (anchor perturbation 0.636 -> 0.439). A free-heat prior mis-set by 0.2-0.4 kW is a second seam (typical_slab 3/12 and 2/6 admitted beyond the bar).

findings.phenomenon_property: For every fit the gate admits, the combined half-width it reads must cover the true UA at its stated 95 % level under the noise the experiment is designed for; admitted fits must not carry a systematic sign of bias.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: sysid.py: carry the first-reading (initial-state) uncertainty into the fit (estimate the initial offset or average the settle readings) and calibrate the adoption interval against an ensemble (e.g. inflate by the measured ensemble/Wald ratio or bootstrap) so admitted fits meet 95 % coverage; pin with a seeded coverage test.

findings.title: sysid step sized to exactly the abort bound: sensor noise aborts 100 of 294 experiments, light_new 81 of 96
findings.claim: With the plant's own max power, SystemIdentification._size_step_power targets a peak equal to max_excursion_c while step() aborts on the same bound, so white sensor noise of 0.01-0.05 degC aborts 100 of 294 experiments (light_new 81 of 96 noisy runs; 47 of 48 at the default 0.5 h cadence) before any fit runs.
findings.mechanism: The sizer's fits() test is peak <= max_excursion_c (headroom only on two-zone plants, TWO_ZONE_SIZING_HEADROOM_C) and _over_excursion aborts on |reading - baseline| > max_excursion_c: a noiseless peak at the bound leaves no margin for the reading's noise.
